+
+`Start(command string, args ...string) (ID int, error)`
+
+When Start is called, it will start executing a the program and return
+a unique identifier for the process. The unique identifier will be
+generated by incrementing an integer upon each time a service
+starts.
+
+Once a process is started, the `stdout` and `stderr` of the process
+will be written out to files by the name of ID.stdout and ID.stderr
+respectively, this will aid in easy log querying without need for
+locking a mutex, and reduce memory needed for noisy logs.
+
+In a real implementation non local storage could be used for logs such
+as Amazon S3 or a self hosted equivalent.
+
